- Building management is asking each tenant to notify its employees. No other action requested of us.

I've drafted the staff note (draft_0003) — it covers the resurfacing, the keep-out instruction, and a heads-up to pass it along to anyone who'd miss the email. Want me to adjust the wording, or is it good to send before the meeting?
